SavedSeed.title: SavedSeed
SavedSeed.description: A user's saved Minecraft world seed suggestion and metadata.

seedValue.description: Numeric or alphanumeric Minecraft world seed.

title.description: Descriptive title for the world seed.

spawnBiome.description: Primary biome near the spawn point.

summary.description: Detailed description of resources, terrain, and features.

userWishPrompt.description: Original user preferences used to suggest this seed.

highlights.description: Up to 10 key feature tags for this world.

isFavorite.description: Whether the seed is starred by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when saved; clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated; clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/savedSeeds/{seedId}.description: User-scoped collection of saved Minecraft world seeds.
